description: Get the transcript of the speech in the timeline, in timeline time (microseconds), the coordinates apply_cuts uses. Each entry names the clip it comes from.

fromUs.description: Only entries ending after this time, in microseconds (1 second = 1000000).

toUs.description: Only entries starting before this time, in microseconds (1 second = 1000000).

wordLevel.description: Return one entry per word instead of per segment.
